_comment: RAM regions used by the tektagt differential snapshots. Addresses are KSEG0 virtual addresses (0x80000000 + physical). The regions tile the whole 4 MB RAM without gaps or overlaps (checked by snapshotlib.check_regions). PROVISIONAL: the boundaries are heuristic, derived from two MAME RAM dumps of the real game (frame 367 'first RAM PC' and frame 1500) at 4 KB granularity, NOT from a linker map (the game image is a raw blob, there is no ELF). Evidence per region is in 'evidence'. Per-page hashes (page_size) in every snapshot allow the boundaries to be refined later without recapturing the reference.

regions.name: kernel
regions.evidence: 0x0..0x9000 holds MIPS code (jr ra / addiu sp density), exception vectors at 0x80, 3 of 16 pages change between frame 367 and 1500

regions.name: data
regions.evidence: 0x80010000..0x800f9000: loaded image head, no function epilogues; pages 0x80030000..0x800a0000 change continuously (work buffers)

regions.name: code
regions.evidence: 0x800f9000..0x80194000: every page has jr ra / addiu sp,sp,-N density >= 4 except a few data-in-text pages; 0x18f000,0x193000 pages change (embedded variables)

regions.name: rodata
regions.evidence: 0x80194000..0x80244000: no function epilogues, nonzero, last nonzero word of the loaded image at 0x8024349c; mostly unchanged

regions.name: bss
regions.evidence: 0x80244000..0x803df000: all-zero at frame 367 (image tail is zero filled), written later (heap/bss)

regions.name: overlay
regions.evidence: 0x803df000..0x803f0000: code-like pages appear here after frame 367 (overlay loaded from banked ROM, seen near 0x803eff54)

regions.name: stack
regions.evidence: initial sp 0x803fffc8; top of RAM; dead part below sp is garbage -> compare stack_live instead
